steps.name: Diaz
steps.text: No. There's absolutely no way I'm letting Reynell's lackeys join our festival as long as I'm here.

steps.name: Diaz
steps.text: The festival is just around the corner, and I have to make sure nothing goes wrong.

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: But they've already returned the medicine, and Reynell is fine with it too...

steps.name: Diaz
steps.text: We don't know what they could be hiding up their sleeves. Can you promise me that their intentions are only good?

steps.name: Diaz
steps.text: Why so quiet, Tecno?

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: Papá, I know they're Reynell's people, the papers are full of pictures of them and Reynell together. There's no arguing that.

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: But that day... when my Oripathy flared up, I fell to the ground and couldn't move. I was all alone... I thought I was done for.

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: Just as I was about to accept my fate, they showed up and saved me, and brought me back to the neighborhood.

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: I felt the same kind of despair in that fire many years ago, Papá. Until you came and saved me from the flames.

steps.name: Diaz
steps.text: How's that the same thing? I'm a firefighter, Tecno. Saving you is my job, and I wanted nothing more than that. But them? Are you sure they have no ulterior motives?

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: I'll get someone to keep an eye on them if you're worried. Can't we just let them watch, Papá? Please?

steps.name: Diaz
steps.text: Why are you being so stubborn, Tecno? If you vouch for them... you'll be the first one blamed if something really goes wrong.

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: Come on, Papá. I won't let them make any trouble.

steps.name: Diaz
steps.text: *sigh* Why do you always start acting so spoiled every time we argue?

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: Oh... please, Papá, please...

steps.name: Diaz
steps.text: Fine. Stop batting your eyelashes, it doesn't work on me.

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: But it used to...

steps.name: Diaz
steps.text: Is that so? You didn't have such outrageously colorful hair then, you didn't drape yourself in black yet, and didn't make clinking noises with every step.

steps.name: Diaz
steps.text: Ya estuvo suave... *sigh* What's wrong with dressing up all pretty like you did before?

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: Hmph...

steps.name: Diaz
steps.text: Enough. Quit your pouting and get their leader to come find me for a quick talk.

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: Should I tell her to come here?

steps.name: Diaz
steps.text: No, we'll chat on the beach.

steps.name: Diaz
steps.text: Miss Ela. Do you know why I'm here?

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: Probably not for the beach.

steps.name: Diaz
steps.text: I'm sure this beach is nothing compared to the amazing views you must enjoy working for Reynell.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: Hard to say. A clean beach behind an alley full of trash makes for a surprisingly pleasant view. The way the light hits is much prettier than how it shines on the neighborhood.

steps.name: Diaz
steps.text: Nothing much we can do about that. There's too many buildings with uneven heights there.

steps.name: Diaz
steps.text: As for the trash... it used to be even worse. I had to bring a team here myself to clear it all, and now any aspiring litterbug faces my wrath.

steps.name: Diaz
steps.text: I believe anyone visiting Dossoles should always get a chance to enjoy the beach.

steps.name: Diaz
steps.text: Am I right, Miss Ela?

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: I didn't come here to litter, Mr. Diaz. Only to enjoy the view, same as you are now.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: I like how clean and quiet it is. No rowdy tourists or casino ads in sight.

steps.name: Diaz
steps.text: That's because the wind is so strong here, no one wants to develop the area.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: I can see it in the trees. Their leaves only grow where the wind doesn't blow.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: They're resilient, and they still thrive even though la brisa is so strong.

steps.name: Diaz
steps.text: You mean el viento.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: Sorry, I'm not good with your local language.

steps.name: Diaz
steps.text: Miss Ela... you say you just want to watch us, and it's not like we have anything to hide. But you should remember to keep your hands to yourself at all times.

steps.name: Diaz
steps.text: Tecno likes hanging out with you, and the community is happy to have your people here as well, so I'll play the bad guy here.

steps.name: Diaz
steps.text: If you betray her trust and hurt her feelings, I'll make sure you pay the price, even if it costs me my life.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: You care very much for Miss Tecno. Isn't she just your subordinate?

steps.name: Diaz
steps.text: I never married or had children. Since I saved her from a fire, she has essentially become my daughter.

steps.name: Diaz
steps.text: That's all I have to say. I'll leave the rest for you to decide.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: What a roundabout way of showing paternal love.

steps.name: Doc
steps.text: (Whispering) An infectious disease caused by an industrial mineral that people here can't live without. It manifests discreetly, has a variety of symptoms and so far, cannot be cured...

steps.name: Doc
steps.text: (Whispering) I can't imagine what it would be like if something like oil was infectious...

steps.name: Tequila
steps.text: Did you say something, Señor Gustave?

steps.name: Doc
steps.text: Oh, nothing. Just rambling to myself.

steps.name: Tequila
steps.text: Here's the medicine and equipment you asked for. Anything you need?

steps.name: Doc
steps.text: I think this should be enough.

steps.name: Tequila
steps.text: Since the loss of the doctor in charge of this neighborhood, there's been a shortage of medical help here. Everyone's glad that you've been lending a hand.

steps.name: Tequila
steps.text: Ah, that's his notebook on Oripathy over there. He was Infected many years before he eventually... *sigh*

steps.name: Doc
steps.text: I can tell from just his handwriting that he was patient and meticulous in his work.

steps.name: Tequila
steps.text: All of us do miss him very much.

steps.name: Tequila
steps.text: Oh, also, about the people you were looking for... I sent a Messenger to get your request out quick.

steps.name: Tequila
steps.text: I only met them a few times before, so I'm not too sure if those operators are the same ones you've been looking for, but... having hope is better than having nothing, right?

steps.name: Doc
steps.text: Certainly. I can't thank you enough.

steps.name: Doc
steps.text: But... a Messenger?

steps.name: Tequila
steps.text: That's right.

steps.name: Doc
steps.text: Do you not have international calling here?

steps.name: Tequila
steps.text: International...?
Señor Ernesto, I have an appointment today, and it's now.

steps.name: Tequila
steps.text: Oh, it's you, Ellie. This is Señor Gustave, our new doctor.

steps.name: Small Child
steps.text: Hello, Señor Gustave. Mama made some bread for the new doctor, so this is yours.

steps.name: Doc
steps.text: Oh, please thank her for me. What kind of bread is it?

steps.name: Small Child
steps.text: A ker-sont.

steps.name: Doc
steps.text: Non, my little friend. It's croissant. You say it like this, 'cwuh-son'.

steps.name: Small Child
steps.text: Weird... no one says it like that...

steps.name: Doc
steps.text: Trust me, that's the proper way.

steps.name: Tequila
steps.text: Eh? Don't most people usually pronounce it like 'ker-sont?'

steps.name: Doc
steps.text: Non, non... I can't believe this is happening.

steps.name: Small Child
steps.text: Are you okay, doctor? You don't look so good.

steps.name: Doc
steps.text: *ahem* No, I'm fine... have you been feeling unwell at all lately?

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: Hey, you two! That arm needs to be a bit higher, so it can connect to the shoulder later.

steps.name: Operating Crew
steps.text: You got it!

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: Making two puppets dance together... ambitious.

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: It took us half a year from concept to making the actual thing, but it looks like our efforts haven't been in vain.

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: Did you plan all this?

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: Me? No, the original idea came from Papá.

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: M-Mr. Diaz? I can't believe he'd actually...

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: The year that fire happened was particularly dry. When the dance hall went up in flames, the blaze was so intense that people couldn't escape.

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: It was Papá then who insisted on fighting the fire and saving us despite the orders he had. He tried his best, but couldn't save everyone...

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: The fire scarred us all, and nobody wants to talk about it. We can't dance the night away like before. Not with all that pain still inside us.

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: But within the last few years, people have slowly regained the desire to dance.

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: Except for Papá... he still feels guilty over the people he couldn't save.

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: And yet he still went and proposed this...

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: Papá says he can't dance with everyone, but he can at least be the one that gets everyone together.

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: You know what, Tecno?

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: I was shocked when I first got here. Chaotic city planning has the place crammed with illegally built structures and jam-packed with people. I thought the whole place was a giant fire hazard.

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: But there are lots of fire-fighting facilities in your streets and alleys. You've got quick evacuation routes and plans in every building.

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: And then I thought, whoever runs this place is actually pretty capable.

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: And I'm doubly sure of that now.

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: That goes without saying...

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: Hey, what's going on over there?

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: What happened? I think that arm stopped moving.

steps.name: Operating Crew Director
steps.text: What's going on?

steps.name: Operating Crew
steps.text: This is bad, the arm got tangled with the puppet's body cables when it moved.

steps.name: Operating Crew Director
steps.text: Can we detach and reposition it?

steps.name: Operating Crew
steps.text: No, it's jammed pretty tight.

steps.name: Operating Crew Director
steps.text: Where, exactly? I'll get someone to untangle it.

steps.name: Operating Crew
steps.text: It's an awkward spot... between the third and fourth floors, far away from the windows.

steps.name: Operating Crew Director
steps.text: Use a safety harness?

steps.name: Operating Crew
steps.text: Maybe... we'll give it a try.

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: Isn't it kind of dangerous to send someone down from the eighth floor like that? That's much higher than the puppet's head.

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: They don't have other options... They can't find a spot to anchor their ropes on lower floors.

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: Can you not move it with a remote control...? Oh, that building's outer walls don't have any good spots for easy climbing.

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: We handcrafted these puppets and their internal structure is real complicated... only someone super familiar with them could handle this.

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: Be careful...

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: Almost... just a little bit more to the left—

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: Oh no! The technician fell!

steps.name: Operating Crew
steps.text: Phew... he's fine, he has a safety harness on.

steps.name: Operating Crew Director
steps.text: Can he try again?

steps.name: Operating Crew
steps.text: I'm afraid not... that drop has his legs shaking uncontrollably.

steps.name: Trembling Voice
steps.text: No, hermano... I really can't do it, I'm afraid of heights... I, I...

steps.name: Operating Crew Director
steps.text: But you're the one who's the most familiar with the puppets' internals... anyone else would just find it near impossible to fix...

steps.name: Trembling Voice
steps.text: No... it was so scary, when I fell... I really thought I was a goner...

steps.name: Trembling Voice
steps.text: Wh-Why not call Tecno? She... designed it, after all...

steps.name: Operating Crew
steps.text: Tecno! Tecno!

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: Is he alright?

steps.name: Operating Crew
steps.text: He's fine, but he's scared out of his wits. So the boss was hoping you could try your hand at it...

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: I don't know a thing about the insides, though.

steps.name: Operating Crew
steps.text: Huh? Didn't you design them?

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: I mean, I only designed what they look like, I wasn't involved in the actual production.

steps.name: Operating Crew
steps.text: Then... wh-what should we do?

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: Tecno, mind letting me and Fuze have a try? We both have experience with heavy machinery.

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: Huh? Miss Ela, you're already done talking with Papá?

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: Give us a chance, Tecno.

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: But didn't Papá say...?

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: I can help out too, Tecno. We all have some engineering experience, so I'm sure we can do something.

steps.name: Operating Crew
steps.text: You're not afraid of heights, Señorita? That's the eighth floor... Knowing theory isn't exactly enough.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: I once dropped out of a twenty-story building, mister. This'll be a piece of cake.

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: No, you can't do that... You stay here, I'll go up myself.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: Tecno?

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: I'm sorry, Ela. It's not that I doubt you, but I promised Papá I wouldn't let you participate, no matter what.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: But will you be able to fix it, Tecno?

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: I'll try my best.

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: *sigh*...

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: Can you do me a favor, Meijer?

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: Of course. What is it?

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: Those guys over there with their eyes on me? Get them off my tail if they follow me, I need to find Fuze.

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: Oh, so Papá Diaz sent some backup.

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: I can do it, but where are you going?

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: Up there. There's no way Tecno can handle the big guy.

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: Ela! Hey!

steps.name: Alert Community Guard
steps.text: Damn it, where did that lady go?

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: *sigh*

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: Sorry, Mister, but I need your help with something!

steps.name: Alert Community Guard
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Alert Community Guard
steps.text: Ugh...

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: You can't just sleep here.

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: Miłosz?

steps.name: Miłosz
steps.text: That mechanical restorationist from Iberia is here. Are you ready to see her?

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: Of course, bring her in.

steps.name: Restorationist
steps.text: Señor Reynell. May I ask what it is you need me to see?

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: The music box, on the table.

steps.name: Restorationist
steps.text: Oh... the famous designer Alizja's sensational masterpiece from fifteen years ago... it is truly beautiful.

steps.name: Restorationist
steps.text: I can feel a sense of comforting tranquility...

steps.name: Restorationist
steps.text: Just look at the carving of the female figure on the lid. Serene and beautiful, her eyes full of compassion, with a faint hint of bitterness on her lips. Truly an indescribable work of beauty.

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: You can spare me the details, madam. I've spent the past several days with it, so I'm well acquainted with its form.

steps.name: Restorationist
steps.text: The drum is badly damaged, and I'm not sure it can be fully repaired.

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: It's fine, that was my doing. I don't need it repaired.

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: There is a music score in the center of the box, and I hope you can make a new drum to play that.

steps.name: Restorationist
steps.text: A hidden compartment?
The man picks up the music box from the table and turns it upside-down. He lodges a fingernail into the seemingly tightly sealed bottom panel, and it opens to reveal a folded note inside.
Reynell carefully unfolds the note and places it on the table, its yellowed hue showing its age.
It is a neatly handwritten music score.

steps.name: Restorationist
steps.text: How did you know about this hidden compartment?

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: Oh, I was there when my mother worked on this box. I saw her put the note in there.

steps.name: Fuze
steps.text: Are you sure about this? Going up to the eighth floor from here and then rappelling down?

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: Of course, it's the quickest way to get to our target.

steps.name: Fuze
steps.text: Also the most dangerous way.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: You don't trust me to keep you from falling?

steps.name: Fuze
steps.text: No, I do. But we are not welcome here.

steps.name: Fuze
steps.text: Such a public move will only make us a target for criticism when they decide to make us their enemies.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: You're talking more than usual.

steps.name: Fuze
steps.text: And you're talking less sense than usual.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: I just don't want their idea to go to waste.

steps.name: Fuze
steps.text: Why are you so concerned with these delusional artists?

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: What's wrong with delusions? It just means jaws will drop to the ground when they actually succeed in their impossibly difficult self-imposed challenges.

steps.name: Fuze
steps.text: When you put it that way, all our operations are just like that.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: And who would say otherwise?

steps.name: Fuze
steps.text: You need to move fast when you land. People are after us and they'll catch up soon.

steps.name: Fuze
steps.text: But don't rush yourself either. I'll buy you enough time.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: ...Thanks.
